normalized_matching_profile.description: Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. Capistrano #203, Seacrest Beach at 30a Brought to you by Beach Blue Properties. *For groups, please inquire about #202 right next door! Designer beachfront condo "Hygge" on 30A with Private beach. Free Beach service (2 beach chairs in season mid March - Oct.). Spectacular views! Steps to Alys and Rosemary Beach. Enjoy incredible gulf front views free from crowds! Capistrano #203, lovingly named "Hygge", is a designer gulf front condo nestled among the palms along 30A - just steps from the sugar white sand and emerald-green waters of the Gulf of Mexico! Our 2nd floor fully remodeled 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom getaway offers designer décor, luxurious furnishings, a fully equipped kitchen, a waterfront balcony and unobstructed views of the glistening gulf! There is no pool, but you won't miss it. The direct and private beach access is merely steps away. Guests can enjoy private beach access with 1 complimentary beach setup as well as an array of nearby restaurants, boutiques, art galleries, and more! *Please note that Capistrano offers streaming for smart TVs only, and there is no cable offered. The fully equipped kitchen features quartz countertops as well as stainless steel appliances and is equipped with all the cookware and dinnerware needed to prepare a gourmet meal. And with seating for 3 at the breakfast bar and seating for 6 at the dining table, there is room for everyone to enjoy! Designed with relaxation in mind, the coastal style living area offers plush furnishings with a sleeper sofa, and a large SmartTV. Oversized sliding glass doors provide access to a furnished balcony and allow floods of natural light to enter this carefully curated space. The guest bedroom is furnished with a brand new king bed and has convenience to a hallway bath with a tub/shower combo. The primary bedroom is located near the entry and offers a luxurious king bed with a new mattress, an HDTV, and access to an ensuite bathroom with tub/shower combo. For your convenience, complimentary high-speed WIFI is provided . There is a brand-new stackable washer and dryer and one reserved parking spot. Unit 203 is located on the second floor with stairway access the unit. This is a walk up unit with no elevator. *The complex only allows one parking spot per unit. Capistrano is located off South Walton’s Scenic 30a near Camp Creek Lake and just minutes from Seagrove Beach, Alys Beach, and Rosemary Beach. This splendid location is close to many wonderful restaurants, lively bars, art galleries, specialty boutiques and family friendly festivals. And with emerald-green waters and white sand beaches just steps away, a memorable vacation is awaiting at Capistrano #203! Cancellation: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking. The minimum age to rent is 25. Pets are not permitted. Smoking is not permitted. There is a $500 fine for evidence of pets or smoking. NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, transportation fee (for select properties), processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
